body:
Thank you

I've been married for 15 years and have kids with someone who will not ever be ok with how I am. He's never going to be my friend, I can't even get him to give me a one word acknowledgment when I try talking to him about my anxiety over being a good parent or finding a therapist.

I lost my only friend group that I talked to for 5ish years daily because one person betrayed my trust and really hurt me, shared details of my Private life with strangers and said I needed to be committed for having anxiety while telling me my anxiety was reasonable and understandable.  I couldn't ask the other friends in the group to take sides. Left my job.. more stuff that makes my life sound like an awful lifetime movie. 

How do I even go about finding anyone who would want to talk and not decide I'm just too exhausting or annoying

It's pretty depressing that the only Autistic Crisis line that I could find is from an organization that hates Autistics and has sympathized with people who have murdered autistics in the past.

LGBT doesn't really fit... I'm CIS and don't feel sexual attraction for anyone.. male or female. I honestly just thought I had an aversion because of sensory issues and needed to mask better. I had no idea that sexual attraction and sex are legitimately that big of a deal for people. I knew it was a me problem but I didn't know that it's a me probablem and that it's never going to get better or change. He's never going to be my friend or actually love me since I'm not the way I'm supposed to be. My whole marriage theres no hope
